## Version and environment

- App/source version:
- macOS version and architecture:
- Installer or source build (state signing/notarization status if known):

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what you expected and what happened. For AF-related reports, state whether the input was JPEG or RAW and whether metadata was unavailable; do not attach the file or full EXIF.

## Safe reproduction

Use synthetic or explicitly shareable images and anonymized paths. Include only the minimal steps needed to reproduce. Never attach private photos, project databases, logs with personal paths, full EXIF (GPS/serials), credentials, or signing material. Replace actual names and paths with placeholders before posting.

## Checks already tried

List relevant test or verification results and whether the issue reproduces offline. Do not bypass macOS security warnings to reproduce it.
